$comment: The ten commodities of spec section 19. Base price is what a unit fetches at a berth holding exactly its target stock; everything else is derived from stock against that target. Mass is carried mass, so a hold of Ore flies worse than a hold of Leaf. Tiers run raw, refined, consumer, manufactured, luxury, and a tier's members share a price band in tuning.

commodities.name: Ore
commodities.description: Rock with metal in it. Heavy, cheap, and the first thing any new berth ships.

commodities.name: Ice
commodities.description: Water and volatiles. Refined into Propellant, and drunk by everyone who is not.

commodities.name: Grain
commodities.description: Grown under glass on the agricultural concessions. Keeps badly; moves constantly.

commodities.name: Alloy
commodities.description: Ore with the rock taken out. The Thirty holds the Home Roads monopoly on it.

commodities.name: Propellant
commodities.description: What a lane costs. Refined from Ice, sold at every berth that wants return traffic.

commodities.name: Provisions
commodities.description: Food that keeps. Every berth eats; none of them grow enough.

commodities.name: Machinery
commodities.description: Engines, pumps, reactors and the parts that keep them turning.

commodities.name: Circuitry
commodities.description: Light, valuable and fragile. Bridges, turret gear and shield controllers.

commodities.name: Ordnance
commodities.description: Rounds and warheads. The Reprisal Company holds the Home Roads monopoly on it.

commodities.name: Leaf
commodities.description: A mild stimulant, grown only in the Marque and chewed throughout the Home Roads. The long haul everyone eventually tries.
